mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as accommodative policy sustains valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS <0.25%, or Rank IC <0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals weak labor market and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with UNRATE >8.0%, or Rank IC <0.02 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days via improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS rising, or interaction term Rank IC <0.03 over 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 228.0 in low-rate environment signals inflationary pressure requiring policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with CPIAUCSL >228.0, or Rank IC <0.02 over 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth above 133,000 signals labor market strengthening and rising consumer confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with PAYEMS >133,000, or Rank IC <0.02 over 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 97.0 indicates manufacturing weakness and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days via immediate risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with INDPRO <97.0, or Rank IC <0.02 over 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals overheating and imminent policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of late-cycle expansion periods with GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC <0.02 over 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise signals Fed's 'soft landing' response to inflation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days via reduced rate hike fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS falling and CPIAUCSL rising, or interaction term Rank IC <0.03 over 6-month window.
